title: EzCompass
description: Shows your compass, lodestone compass, recovery compass, and clock near the hotbar.
body:
# EzCompass

EzCompass is a small client-side quality-of-life mod that shows useful navigation items near your hotbar when they are in your inventory.

It can display your compass, lodestone compass, recovery compass, and clock without needing to keep them in your hotbar.

## Features

- Shows compass near the hotbar
- Supports lodestone compass
- Supports recovery compass
- Supports clock
- Fully client-side
- Works on multiplayer servers
- The server does not need to install the mod
- Hides items that are already in your hotbar
- Mod Menu support
- HUD ON/OFF toggle
- Toggle each item type individually
- Move the HUD with a draggable preview box
- Reset HUD position
- Reverse Order option
- Fill-from-end behavior when Reverse Order is enabled
- Auto move support for left-hand mode

## Requirements

Required:
- Fabric API

Optional:
- Mod Menu

Mod Menu is optional, but recommended if you want to change the settings in-game.

## Multiplayer

EzCompass is fully client-side and works on multiplayer servers.  
Other players and the server do not need to install it.

## Notes

Items that are already in the hotbar will not be shown by EzCompass, because they are already visible in the vanilla hotbar.
